title: Connect agents to any website. No API needed.
excerpt: Pomerado turns any website into an API/MCP in minutes. Faster and more reliable than browser agents. Open source.
content_html:
Backed by Y Combinator

Connect agents to any website. No API needed.

Pomerado turns any website into an API/MCP in minutes. Faster and more reliable than browser agents. Open source.

Using an agent? Copy setup prompt

7 reasons to pick Pomerado

  1. Faster and more reliable than browser agents

    Customers have seen 7x speedups. Browser agents reason through every page. Pomerado builds deterministic APIs that run in seconds.

  2. Validated on real-world benchmarks

    Pomerado is 2x faster, 10 to 1,000 times cheaper, and 30% more accurate than Astra Computer Use, Instinct, and Muse for browser use.

  3. Self-healing integrations

    When a site changes, Pomerado catches the break, repairs the integration and finishes the call. Your agent gets its result, not an error.

  4. Build integrations from your coding agent

    Ask Codex, Claude, or Cursor for an integration. Pomerado builds and tests it while your agent oversees the work.

  5. Integrate with any website

    Create an API for any website with a single prompt. We've handled legacy portals, consumer websites, and internal vendor tools.

    • Prior auth portals
    • EMRs
    • ERPs
    • CRMs
    • Payer portals
    • Claims systems
    • AR/AP systems
    • Legal forms
    • Government filings
    • Procurement portals
    • Vendor portals
    • HR systems
    • Benefits enrollment
    • Insurance quoting
    • Billing systems
    • Scheduling tools
    • Support desks
    • Compliance filings
    • Bank portals
    • Shipping carriers

  6. You deploy nothing

    Every integration arrives hosted, scaled, and access controlled. There is no infrastructure for your team to stand up.

  7. Authentication and 2FA managed for you

    Pomerado handles sign-in for every integration, including sites that require two-factor codes or one-time passwords.

FAQ

Can the integration log into sites and act behind a login?

Yes. Integrations authenticate into portals, dashboards, and internal tools to read data and take actions.

Do I need to store my credentials?

No. You can use Pomerado without storing any credentials: simply pass any needed logins with your API request. For convenience, we also offer secure credential storage, including 2FA. Note: Pomerado securely retains hashes of sign-in identifiers to enforce single-login limits per website.

What about captchas, rate limits, and getting blocked?

We natively enforce rate limits and handle anti-bot measures (e.g., with residential proxies) to protect customers from those risks.

What data does Pomerado retain?

We only persist data necessary to keep the API working for a particular site. Task results are erased once delivered, or within 60 minutes if never read, and credentials are stored only if you choose to save them.

How do you handle PII and sensitive information?

We use state of the art models to redact and strip out PII, so sensitive details aren't kept once your task is done.

What do we need to get started?

Create an account and connect to the Pomerado API or MCP.

Contact us

Whether you are sharpening a personal assistant, automating a legacy process, or streamlining an internal workflow, Pomerado can accelerate you and your team.

FAQ

Can the integration log into sites and act behind a login?

是的。 Integrations authenticate into portals, dashboards, and internal tools to read data and take actions.

Do I need to store my credentials?

No. You can use Pomerado without storing any credentials: simply pass any needed logins with your API request. For convenience, we also offer secure credential storage, including 2FA. Note: Pomerado securely retains hashes of sign-in identifiers to enforce single-login limits per website.

What about captchas, rate limits, and getting blocked?

We natively enforce rate limits and handle anti-bot measures (e.g., with residential proxies) to protect customers from those risks.

What data does Pomerado retain?

We only persist data necessary to keep the API working for a particular site. Task results are erased once delivered, or within 60 minutes if never read, and credentials are stored only if you choose to save them.

How do you handle PII and sensitive information?

We use state of the art models to redact and strip out PII, so sensitive details aren't kept once your task is done.

What do we need to get started?

Create an account and connect to the Pomerado API or MCP.
